title: Franks and Beans
description: Sliced hot dogs simmered with vegetarian baked beans, ketchup and brown sugar.

steps.instruction: Slice hot dogs into 3/8 inch pieces and boil for 15 to 20 minutes.
Drain hot dogs and add remaining ingredients.
Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally to avoid scorching.

notes: Transcription note: Yield not stated in original; recorded as 1 batch (one #10 can of beans).
Timing estimated; not stated in original. Prep time estimated from the stated 15 to 20 minute boil plus slicing; cook time is the stated 15 minute simmer.
